rules.one_move: Only ONE primary camera move per shot. Stacking moves causes jitter.
rules.state_static: If the camera must not move, say it explicitly: 'locked-off static camera, never moves'.
rules.micro_magnitude: Any small motion needs a number: centimetres and seconds. Never 'subtle' alone.
rules.no_zoom_word: Never use 'zoom' for a physical move — name dolly / push in / track.
rules.one_beat: One beat per 4-second clip. Several actions in one clip = all of them half-done.
rules.emotion_to_body: Never write an emotion; write the body that shows it.
rules.end_state: Anchor the last frame: 'by the last frame ...'.
rules.environment: Give one independent background motion (rain, steam, leaves) so the frame stays alive.
rules.negative: Always: no text, no subtitle, no camera movement, no warping, no morphing.

camera.en: locked-off static camera on a tripod, the camera never moves, no zoom, no pan, no handheld
camera.fa: دوربین قفل روی سه‌پایه، هیچ حرکتی ندارد

camera.en: static camera, then a single slow re-frame of {cm} cm toward the subject over the full {sec} seconds
camera.fa: دوربین ثابت، سپس یک بازقاب‌بندی آرام

camera.en: the camera pushes in only {cm} cm over the full {sec} seconds — slow enough to barely register, no zoom
slow dolly push from medium shot to medium close-up over the full {sec} seconds
slow dolly out revealing the empty street, constant speed over {sec} seconds
steady lateral track left alongside the subject at walking pace
steady lateral track right alongside the subject at walking pace
slow tilt up following the subject's upward gaze, one direction only
smooth {deg}-degree orbit at eye level, constant distance, no speed change
handheld, barely perceptible drift, no shake, no reframing
camera.fa: دوربین روی دست با لرزش نامحسوس

camera.en: camera follows from behind at a steady walking pace, keeping the same distance

shot_size.en: two-shot with both faces in frame

subject.en: she rises from the bench — weight shifts forward, hands push off the slat, coat falls straight
she walks two steps toward him and stops with her weight on the front foot
subject.fa: دو قدم به سمت او می‌رود و می‌ایستد

subject.en: her arms come up around his shoulders and stay there; his free arm settles across her back and stays; from this moment neither moves their feet
subject.fa: در آغوش می‌گیرد و همان‌جا می‌ماند

subject.en: she turns her head toward camera, eyes finding the lens, chin lifting slightly
subject.fa: سر را به سمت دوربین می‌چرخاند

subject.en: she lowers her gaze to the wet pavement and holds it
he looks up at the streetlamp above them, then back at her
one long exhale: shoulders drop, chest falls, head lowers a few degrees
she takes one step back, hands sliding off his coat, and stops
he lifts the umbrella a few centimetres so it covers her shoulder too, then holds it still
he tilts the umbrella toward her and lets go of the handle; her hand closes around it
she lowers herself onto the bench, hands finding the edge first
he reaches one hand toward her, palm up, and waits without moving
subject.fa: دستش را به سمت او دراز می‌کند

subject.en: she wipes rain from her cheek with the back of her hand, once
subject.fa: باران را از صورتش پاک می‌کند

subject.en: she turns and walks away from camera at a steady pace, not looking back
both stand completely still, only breathing

micro.en: her fingers tighten once on the coat hem and release
his jaw tightens once, then eases
micro.fa: فک قفل می‌شود و باز می‌شود

micro.en: breath visible in the cold air, two slow breaths in the shot
one wet strand of hair moves across her cheek and stays
micro.fa: یک تار مو روی گونه می‌افتد

micro.en: his collar shifts once as he turns his head, then settles
the umbrella tilts back no more than a few centimetres and settles
micro.fa: چتر چند سانتی‌متر برمی‌گردد و آرام می‌گیرد

micro.en: water drips from the umbrella edge in irregular intervals

body: throat moves once as she swallows
weight leans into the other person

environment.en: rain falling steadily through the cone of the streetlamp
soft bokeh of passing traffic far behind them, out of focus
wet asphalt holding long reflections of the lamp
a thin steam rising from a vent on the left, drifting slowly
a hanging sign sways slightly in the wind
two headlights approach slowly from the far end of the street
environment.fa: دو چراغ ماشین از دور نزدیک می‌شود

look.en: photorealistic, 35mm, shallow depth of field, warm practical lamp against teal shadows, film grain
photorealistic close-up, 85mm, very shallow depth of field, rim light on wet hair, film grain
photorealistic wide, 28mm, deep focus, wet street reflections, film grain

negative.default: no text, no subtitle, no watermark, no camera shake, no zoom, no warping, no morphing, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no duplicated limbs, no frame reversal
negative.static: no camera movement at all, no drift, no reframing, no text, no subtitle
